subject: planner: avoid scanning multi-valued index when there is no condition related (#50183)
summary:
Reviewed diff vs first parent, focusing on planner MV-index path generation and hint handling.
- Confirmed planner now refuses to build MV-index IndexMerge partial paths when no predicate covers the array virtual column (`pkg/planner/core/indexmerge_path.go`: `buildPartialPaths4MVIndex`), avoiding incorrect result loss for rows with empty arrays.
- Confirmed `USE/FORCE INDEX` selecting only MV indexes no longer leads to “no physical plan” failures by ensuring a table path remains available (`pkg/planner/core/planbuilder.go`: `getPossibleAccessPaths`).
- Confirmed MV-index hints are still honored when a valid MV IndexMerge path exists via pruning to IndexMerge paths containing the hinted MV index (`pkg/planner/core/indexmerge_path.go`: `cleanAccessPathForMVIndexHint` / `indexMergeContainSpecificIndex`).
No plausible remaining Blocker/High correctness/semantics issues found in the touched planner/executor behavior.
